S60.02.needs: a paid account with AGI Work (the Tasks menu row appears only when signed in)
S60.02.note: The Tasks sheet has no rename control; the only rename found is for chat history entries, and it is not confirmed to change the task title.
steps: Sign in, click the More button (aria-label "More") in the side panel header.
Click "Tasks" to open the Tasks sheet.
Look at each task row: the bold line is the task title, or "Untitled task" when none is set.
Click Recent chats (the history icon in the header), find the chat, open More actions and click Rename; type a name in "Chat name" and save.
Reopen Tasks and compare the title with Expected.
S60.02.where: More > Tasks (the task list shows each title; titles are read-only there). To change a title, use Recent chats > More actions > Rename

S60.13.needs: a paid account with AGI Work
S60.13.note: The plan card is skipped for unattended runs and for goals longer than the AGI Work goal limit; the toggle label in code is spAgiWork, shown as "AGI Work" in messages.json.
steps: Sign in with an account whose plan includes AGI Work, then open the model menu (aria-label "Available models").
Turn on the AGI Work toggle (row label "AGI Work").
Type a multi-step goal in the composer and send it.
Look for the plan card headed "Plan" with the help text "Edit any step before the work starts. The agent follows the plan you start here."
Edit a step or click "Add a step", then click "Start work" (or "Cancel") and compare with Expected.
S60.13.where: Available models menu > turn on "AI Work" toggle, then send a goal in the composer; the plan appears before work starts

S60.14.needs: a Free or paid account; a task that uses tools
S60.14.note: Per-step status is rendered in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts; accuracy is not checked here.
steps: Send a request that uses tools, such as a research task, in a chat with AGI Work on.
While it runs or after it ends, click the activity line that starts with "Working for" or "Worked for".
Read the step rows that appear under it, each with a summary and an elapsed time.
Compare each step's status (running, failed, cancelled) with what the run actually did.
S60.14.where: Chat > the activity line under the reply (e.g. "Working for …" with "N steps") > click it to expand the step list

S60.16.needs: a Free or paid account; a task that uses tools
S60.16.note: The running-step marker is an icon only (Loader2 in bubbles.ts), with no visible word.
steps: Start a tool-using request and click the "Working for" activity line to expand it.
Find the step row that is still in progress.
Look for its spinning icon (no text label) and compare with Expected: only the executing step should spin.
S60.16.where: Chat > the activity line "Working for …" > expand; the step that is executing shows a spinning icon on its row

S60.18.needs: a Free or paid account; an ambiguous request the agent chooses to clarify
S60.18.note: The card is rendered by buildClarifyCard in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/interactiveCards.ts; whether the agent asks is up to the agent, so the tester may not trigger it on demand.
steps: Send a request that is ambiguous enough for the agent to ask a question, such as an unclear instruction.
Wait for the question card to appear in the reply.
Choose an answer option or type one, then click "Send answers".
Check that the run continues with the answer, and compare with Expected.
S60.18.where: Chat > a clarifying question card inside the reply, answered with the "Send answers" button or "I'll just type it"

S60.19.needs: a Free or paid account; a request that triggers an approval
S60.19.note: The approval card is built in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts; which actions need approval is decided by the agent and policy, so the tester may need to request one.
steps: Send a request that needs an action the agent asks permission for, such as a browser or file action.
When the activity line shows "Needs your approval", click it to expand.
Read the card text "Your approval is required before this tool can run." (or the version with a risk level).
Click "Approve" or "Decline" (or "Allow for this chat"), then check that the run pauses before the decision and continues or stops after it.
S60.19.where: Chat > the activity line "Needs your approval · …" > expand > the approval card with "Approve" or "Decline"

S60.20.note: The only guidance box found is "Add guidance to steer the run (optional)", shown on an approval card (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts), not as a mid-run control; I searched apps/extension/src for steer, redirect and guidance and found no free-text redirect while a run is going.

S60.23.needs: a paid account with a long-running task
S60.23.note: The stop control is in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/tasksSheet.ts and calls cancelChromeManagedRun; the chat's "Stop response" button ends only the reply stream, not the task.
steps: Start a long task and sign in with the same account.
Click More (aria-label "More"), then "Tasks".
On a running task row, click "Stop" and read the confirmation text.
Click "Stop" to confirm, then check the row state and the status line "Task stopped." and compare with Expected.
S60.23.where: More > Tasks > "Stop" on a running task > "Stop" in the confirmation ("Keep running" to cancel)

S60.29.needs: a Free or paid account; a task that finishes
S60.29.note: No separate results-summary block was found; the summary is the final reply itself, so reachability rests on the reply, not a dedicated control.
steps: Send a task and wait until it ends.
Read the reply below the activity line "Worked for …".
Compare the reply with what the task did and with Expected.
S60.29.where: Chat > the final reply after the activity line "Worked for …"

S60.30.needs: a Free or paid account; a task that generates a file
S60.30.note: Built in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/generatedFiles.ts; opening a file (not only downloading) was not confirmed.
steps: Send a request that produces a file, such as a generated report.
Look for the file row in the reply.
Click the download control on the file row (aria-label "Download <file name>").
Check that the file saves and that the status reads "Downloading …" then succeeds or fails, and compare with Expected.
S60.30.where: Chat > the reply's file list > "Download" button on each file

S60.31.needs: a task that ends partly done
S60.31.note: The code shows a status and failed-step count, but no separate "what remains" text was found.
steps: Run a task that is expected to fail partly, such as a browser task on a page that blocks it.
Read the activity line at the end of the reply and expand it.
Check the failed steps shown in the step list.
Open More > Tasks and read the state of the task row, then compare with Expected (what was done and what remains).
S60.31.where: Chat > the activity line "Finished with errors · …" or "Worked for … · N failed attempts", and Tasks > the row state "Partially completed"

S60.32.needs: at least one past task on the account
S60.32.note: "Open" opens the web app in a new tab rather than inside the side panel.
steps: Sign in and click More (aria-label "More"), then "Tasks".
Read the list: each row shows the title, then the state and last-updated time.
Click "Open" on a task with a conversation to open it in a new Chrome tab on the web.
Compare the list and the opened task with Expected.
S60.32.where: More > Tasks (lists tasks with state and time; "Open" on each row)

labels.text: Tasks AGI is running or has run for you, from every app.

S60.34.needs: a second device or the web app with the same account
S60.34.note: The list is built from listChromeManagedRuns, so cross-device listing is inferred from that call; following the task live was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Start a task on a second device or on the web with the same account.
On this Chrome, click More (aria-label "More"), then "Tasks".
Find the task started on the other device in the list and click "Open" or "All tasks on the web".
Check that the task state updates and that Stop works from here, and compare with Expected.
S60.34.where: More > Tasks (runs from every app are listed; "Open" and "Stop" work on them), plus "All tasks on the web" at the bottom of the sheet
